numerical_tolerance: All projections and squared-error reductions use FP64. The SVD rank cutoff is max(W.shape)*eps64*s_max on the saved FP32 weights cast to FP64. Prediction space residual RMS must not exceed 32*eps32*(K+2) times the RMS scale of the prediction, bias, and abs(minimum-norm latent)@abs(W)+abs(bias). This allows FP32 dot-product/bias rounding with a conservative factor 32. The lower-bound MSE tolerance is 2*sqrt(floor_MSE*prediction_space_residual_MSE) + prediction_space_residual_MSE + 64*eps64*max(floor_MSE, actual_MSE), derived from Cauchy-Schwarz on the measured off-space prediction residual. Scientific violations raise ValueError; no bound or rank is tuned to outcomes.
